response.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase

assumptions.assumption: Only executions that match an order are counted (inner join), so the total in the fraction is the total of linked executions across all channels. Executions whose ordersmark is NULL or has no matching order are excluded.
A NULL orderbase forms its own group, which GROUP BY does by default. Executions with a NULL fillcount are still counted in the execution count, but AVG ignores them.
recordvault is unique per order, so the join does not duplicate executions.
